verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile's own documented agent features let a user start one-off Copilot agent tasks and track their progress. Nothing shows the app itself creating or managing recurring schedules. The scheduled 'Automations' and GitHub Actions evidence describes the GitHub.com host platform, not the mobile product, so it earns no credit here. missing for 10: in-app creation of recurring or scheduled jobs/workflows, in-app management of schedules, and any first-party mobile documentation of scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Automations run repository tasks on a schedule or in response to events, rather than requiring a new prompt each time.
Easily start new tasks and keep track of progress while you’re on the move.
